newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE grains jump as sterling easier.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE grains jump as sterling easier.

text.p: LIFFE grains jumped as sterling eased against the mark, traders said.
Active May wheat last traded 1.50 stg up at 95.25 stg, at its high of the day.
May wheat volume was 362 lots of a total 622.
The effect of sterling's fall was magnified by a steady note carried over from late trade Wednesday and some hedge buying by consumers and shippers, according to one trader.
On Wednesday the effect of a sterling rise on the market was much smaller than the effect of Thursday's fall.
There were 15 lots of barley traded, 13 of them on November, which last traded 0.50 stg up at 93.00 stg.
